Born in Bolingbroke, Nova Scotia, Anne Shirley lost her parents in early infancy and spent her early childhood moving between guardians and an asylum [F2, F3, F4, F5, F9, F13].
She quickly swore an oath of lifelong friendship with Diana Barry and developed a fierce, long-standing rivalry with Gilbert Blythe after he pulled her hair at school [S9, S13].

Following years of local schooling and attending Queen's Academy, she gave up her college scholarship to remain at Green Gables after Matthew died, working as the Avonlea teacher to support Marilla [S40, S42, S43].

Throughout her college years, she received and rejected multiple marriage proposals, including an awkward proxy proposal from Jane Andrews on behalf of her brother Billy, as well as an earnest declaration from Gilbert [S87, S100].
Although she spent months courted by Roy Gardner, she ultimately turned down his proposal after realizing she did not love him [S103, S114].
Upon returning to Avonlea after graduation, she discovered that Gilbert had not engaged Christine Stuart as rumored [S113, S116].
Walking together to Hester Gray's garden, Gilbert proposed once more, and Anne joyfully accepted, ending their long misunderstandings and becoming engaged [S116].

Although she spent months courted by Roy Gardner, she ultimately turned down his proposal after realizing she did not love him [S103, S114].
Upon returning to Avonlea after graduation, she discovered that Gilbert had not engaged Christine Stuart as rumored [S113, S116].
Walking together to Hester Gray's garden, Gilbert proposed once more, and Anne joyfully accepted, ending their long misunderstandings and becoming engaged [S116].
